$comment: Test runners of this pack, for `precheck.testRunners` in .factory/config.json (schema: scripts/feature-verification/lib/runners.mjs). Refer to one with "<pack>/<name>" or to all with "<pack>"; runners are tried in this order. `verified` says whether the run command was executed against a sample project when the pack was written.

runners.name: junit-maven
runners.description: JUnit 5 through Maven Surefire, one run per module (nearest pom.xml); the story is a JUnit tag.
runners.verifiedNote: Maven is not installed on the machine the pack was written on. In a multi-module build whose modules depend on each other, replace -f with ["-pl", "{unit}", "-am"].

runners.name: junit-gradle
runners.description: JUnit 5 through Gradle, one run per project (nearest build.gradle); Gradle has no tag flag, so the story is selected by class name.
runners.verifiedNote: Gradle is not installed on the machine the pack was written on.
